content: Saul nawiing nindanjeen vu hil bel-ate

+ o 8:1 Sin 7:58; 8:4; 11:19*Saul yi nivasa in layiis Stiven-ambe yimb. Tombe hôôk busin-anju hil mondawiing nindanjeen vu hil bel-ate sen dando Yelusalem-ato, om hil bel pin lapak-ambe lavuuh taale lohvu Yudia osin Samaalia-te taaku pin, de sinaale-so yoo daahen dando Yelusalem.
Hil anivasa vaalu sen kand navu sapa Anutuu-to ond lahaav Stiven-ande lasu bopaata lak yi,
+ o 8:3 Sin 9:1,13; 22:4; 26:9-11*tonde Saul monawiing nindanjeen vu hil bel-ate pin. Nalukala bayêên alo pin-ambe naandiiy moow ayuuh vêêh danjeen-ambe la natung sil hôôk kalaambus.
Lanêêl banye nivasa vu Samaalia
Hil pin sen lapak-ambe lavuuh taalêê-to ond latup hôôk-ambe lanêêl banye nivasa langaah.
+ o 8:5 Sin 6:5*Tombe Pilip la hato Samaalia-te taaku ti be nêêl Kalisi haale langaah vu sil.
Tombe hil ngeeyaata lôôt lango Pilip-ate vakasin, de layi taahu taahu niwêêk vaha vaha sen wiing-ato, be lawii-having yite vakasin osin londpayo timu.

+ o 8:7 Mat 10:1; Mak 16:17*Tonde hil ngeeyaata sen mamu nipaya nahôôvu sil-ato, ond mamuu-ju dawiing lavand bopaata be lato dala, de hil ngeeyaata sen kook navu tasiis osin vahand anipayaa-to sil anind vasa nahôôk laah,
tombe hil sen dando taakuu-juuto londpayo nivasa lôôt.
De omaaho lôômb ti nando taaku Samaalia haale nambe Simon, ond yoo nako yi lak nambe yi omaaho bopaata. Tombe hil pin lavindis in yite kul,
hil malis osin hil yêêv pin lawii-having Simon-ate vakasin-ambe lanêêl nambe, “Omaahôô-jo Anutu-te niwêêk, danêêl nambe niwêêk bopaata.”
Ond lavindis in yite kul mamu lôômb sen yoo nawiing boyambôôy-ato ondeey lawii-having lava.
Lemu Pilip nêêl va sen Anutu nanggin yite hil-ato osin Yesu Kalisi banye langaah vu sil, tombe moow ayuuh vêêh lawii-having-ambe lalipis bel.
Tonde yik Simon wii-having-ambe lipis bel lung la le mem taamuyin Pilip. Om Simon yi de Pilip wiing taahu taahu vaha vaha osin niwêêk bopaata, tombe vindis lôôt.
De sinaale-so vu Yelusalem ond lango banye nambe hil Samaalia lako Anutu-te tanasin ak, om lawiing Pita yuuh Jon lala vu sil.
Yuuh latok lala be yuuh lalohak in hil-anju nambe Vavi Vaambuung jakana sil,
in Vavi Vaambuung-ame lakala sil e, de lalipis bel lak Omaaho Bop Yesu haale mu.
+ o 8:17 Sin 19:6*Om sinaale yuuh lambe namand ak sil atombe mem Vavi Vaambuung lakala sil.
Tombe Simon yi de sinaale yuuh lambe namand ak sil-ambe Vavi Vaambuung lakala sil, om hako mone be la vu yuuh
be nêêl nambe, “Mambu va niwêêk-anja vu sa gaving in naambe sa gambe namangg jak hil ond Vavi Vaambuung jakana sil.”
Le Pita nêêl vu nambe, “Gambe ombaanggo Anutu-te samu samuu-jo jak mone, om gana menama osin gate mone.
+ o 8:21 Saam 78:37*Vaa-jo game gate va le, malis lôôt. Anutu yi nambe galompayo me-nivalok e,
om ganggilin galompayo de onggaluuh damim vu gate va nipaya, de okataangg vu Omaaho Bop in kawiiy va sen galompayo yoo wiingin-ato na.
+ o 8:23 Hiblu 12:15*Saahe de galompayo nikalin lôôt de gate va nipaya duuh hong tatin.”
Tombe Simon nêêl laah nambe, “Manohak na vu Omaaho Bop naambe va sen manêêl-anjaato me-naatovu sa le.”
Sinaale yuuh lanêêl Omaaho Bop-ate vakasin langaah lung la, tonde yuuh lala in nambe lanaah Yelusalem, tombe sim yuuh lanêêl banye nivasa langaah vu Samaalia-te taaku ngeeyaata vu mopaatôôv.
Pilip nêêl tanasin vu yêêv Itiopia ti
Omaaho Bop-ate angela ti nêêl vu Pilip nambe, “Okandi lak-ambe gana gato mop lavuun sen vu Yelusalem-ambe la hato Gasaa-to.” Mopaatôôv-anju ond taaku lumbalaamb.
+ o 8:27 Ais 56:3-7*Om Pilip kandi lak-ambe la, tombe yi de Itiopia ti hato, ond hil Itiopia-te kwin Kandesi yite yêêv bop sen nanggin yite kupak pin-ato, ond la lohak vu Yelusalem lung la,
tonde hato laah in na, tombe monasevin omaaho sen nanêêl Anutu-te vakasin langaah-ato Yesaia-te vakasin lakando pêêt sen hôôs naandiiy-ato.
Om Vavi Vaambuung nêêl vu Pilip nambe, “Gana ngaaho vu omaahôô-ju be mana.”
Tombe Pilip hatup-ambe la ngaaho vu, le hango de nasevin Yesaia-te vakasin, om lingin nambe, “Vakasin sen onasevin-anja, ond galak danggakook ani me malis?”
+ o 8:31 Jon 16:13*Le omaahôô-ju nêêl laah vu nambe, “Sa jak ni in lati naanêêl vu sa? Omaaho ti naanêêl tatekin vu sa ond mem.” Om nêêl nambe Pilip jakana mando gaving yi.
+ o 8:32 Ais 53:7-8*Ke, omaahôô-ju nasevin Anutu-te vakasin boow ti neep hôôk kaapiya nambe,

content.text: “Langgiiy yi be lala lohvu bik sipsip sen davu lanyiis-ambe jimb-ato, de lohvu bik sipsip noow sen daving nivalus-ande me-nasuu-to, ond omaahôô-ju me-vakaas e.
Tombe laanggôôl yi lôôt de me-lanêêl vakasin anivasa ti lak yi le. De yite hil moos dando tana in nambe yiiy naanêêl sil langaah? Malis, in havuuh ngaanggis voon-anjo de la.”

content: Tombe yêêv tii-jôôto lingin Pilip nambe, “Otatekin vu sa le, naambe Yesaia nêêl vakasin-anjo ond yoo nêêl lak yi me nêêl lak omaaho ango?”
Om Pilip nêêl vakasin-anju be tatekin Yesu-te banye nivasa langaah vu yi,
+ o 8:36 Sin 10:47*de yuuh mondala be lala lato bel ti, tombe yêêv tii-jôôto nêêl nambe, “Angge, bel neep-anjo. Lohvu nambe ganjipis sa pavis me malis?”
[Tombe Pilip nêêl vu nambe, “Galompayo wii-having keen lôôt ond hoow-o.” Le nêêl laah vu nambe, “Saawii-having nambe Yesu Kalisi yi Anutu Noow.”]
Tonde nêêl vu yite omaaho sen nando having yii-to be puvu hees tatin-ande hôôs naale, tonde yuuh Pilip laluus-ambe lalukala daale hôôk bel, tombe mem Pilip lipis yi.
+ o 8:39 1King 18:12*Tonde yuuh vu belalu be lalakalaah atombe Omaaho Bop-ate Vavi Vaambuung vu vêêl Pilip la pavis, de yêêv-anjôôto me-yi Pilip yesin laah e, om la osin lopayo nivasa lôôt.
+ o 8:40 Sin 21:8*Tonde Pilip yi nambe la hato Asdot, tombe nêêl banye nivasa langaah lohvu taaku pin-ambe tok la Sisalia.
